messages:
elena: Quick retrospective — the enrichment backfill last night drove a ~3.2x ingest bump for two hours. We need a concrete ownership + rollout plan so this doesn't repeat. TL;DR: artifacts were duplicate-enriched and some late-join attributes triggered a second enrichment pass.
elena: I want a short checklist we can run before any future backfill + a handoff playbook for infra -> obs team. Thoughts?
raj: ugh saw that spike on the dashboard. looks like the backfill job re-ingested traces that already had the billing_key set, but our dedupe only runs downstream.
raj: proprosal: add a preflight that samples a week of envelopes and runs a quick fingerprint to estimate duplicates. if dup_rate > 5% block.
morgan: +1 on preflight. also we need to be explicit about attribute ownership. who owns `customer_env` vs `runtime_env` vs `billing_key`?
sam: My $0.02 — make `billing_key` authoritative if present on envelope root, and enrichment should be idempotent w.r.t root keys. If enrichment would overwrite an authoritative key, it must log a warn and skip.
luis: agree with idempotency. also suggest we add a new header in the ingest API: `X-Enrich-Run-Id` so a backfill can mark runs and the ingest pipeline can ignore repeats from older run ids. cheap guard.
elena: nice, `X-Enrich-Run-Id` could be enforced at the gateway layer to short-circuit duplicate enrichment. but be careful for device SDKs that don't set headers. fallback: compare (trace_id, billing_key, enrich_version) fingerprint.
raj: infra-bot: deploy status for enrichment-schema-v2?
infra-bot: enrichment-schema-v2 deployed to staging at 2025-01-23T02:18Z, canary 10% running, no errors observed.
morgan: For the checklist, propose: 1) run duplicate estimation SQL, 2) run idempotency dry-run w/ `--no-write`, 3) announce window + run-id to teams, 4) ensure rollback plan + consumer thinning.
sam: sample duplicate estimation query (psql):
```
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE dup>1) / count(*)::float as dup_rate
FROM (SELECT trace_id, billing_key, count(*) as dup FROM staging_envelopes GROUP BY trace_id, billing_key) t;
```
elena: good. add to that `max-fanout` heuristic — if enrichment increases envelope size > x bytes we pause (prevents broker pressure). set x=256kb for now.
luis: ownership doc snippet: `billing_key`: billing-team (authoritative), `customer_env`: product-instrumentation, `runtime_env`: infra-team. keep single-writer rule.
morgan: rollout playbook note: run staged backfill by tenant cohorts (A/B) and measure ingest delta on each cohort for 30m before expanding. auto-stop if delta > 1.8x.
raj: also pump metrics for enrich-run-id coverage: gauge `enrich.run_id.coverage` (percent of envelopes with header). we can use that to require >90% before allowing backfill.
elena: final ask: can infra add the header enforcement + add the dry-run mode to backfill tool? sam/morgan can own the checklist doc and send the announcement template. I'll draft the checklist and loop you in.
sam: I'll add the checklist to the runbook and PR the template.
luis: I'll add the header guard to gateway and export `enrich.run_id.coverage` metric.
morgan: thanks — scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow to finalize. :calendar: 
elena: thanks all :thumbsup:
